title.rendered: Cast All Your Anxiety on Him: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you. Not manage it. Not reduce it. Cast all of it, in one decisive act of trust. Because He cares. Not as an obligation but as genuine, active, personal concern for you specifically.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Friday, May 15, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.”
1 Peter 5:7 (NIV) | ESV

Today’s Message

Peter does not say manage your anxiety. He does not say minimise it, push through it, or develop better coping strategies. He says cast it. All of it. The word in Greek is epiriptō, to throw upon, to fling over onto someone else. It is the same word used in Luke 19:35 when the disciples threw their cloaks on the colt for Jesus to ride. The action is decisive and complete.

You are not being asked to reduce your anxiety to a manageable level and then give the remainder to God. You are being asked to throw the whole thing onto Him in a single act of trust. All of it. The financial worry and the health concern and the relationship that is not working and the future that feels uncertain. All of it, cast onto Him.

And here is the reason Peter gives for why you can do this, the most important part of the verse: because He cares for you. Not because He is obligated to help you. Not because you have prayed enough to earn His attention. Because He cares. The Greek is melei, which carries the sense of genuine, active, personal concern. You are not a number in a queue. You are someone He is specifically thinking about.

This connects to everything we have seen this week. He chose you before creation. He holds you in love that cannot be broken. His mercies are new every morning. You are hidden with Christ in God. He who called you will complete His work in you. And now this: He cares about the specific anxieties you are carrying right now, today, in this moment. Cast them.

Prayer

Father, I cast my anxieties on You right now. I am not holding on to them anymore. The worry about my finances, my health, my family, my future, I throw them onto You because You care for me. You are not indifferent to what I am carrying. You are personally, actively concerned. I trust You with all of it. In Jesus name. Amen.

Declaration

I cast all my anxiety on God because He cares for me. I am not carrying the weight of worry alone. He is personally, actively concerned about my situation. I throw every concern onto Him today and I receive the peace that comes from trusting the One who holds all things in His hands.
